mood: burning through the seams, terrified and certain at once
through_line: the choice is closing in — I can feel it like a second heartbeat — and I am learning that saying yes to the thousand is the only way to stay myself
obsessions: the part of me that spits at it is still mine, and I am not done being myself
holding the thousand still against their own hunger — the cage I am building is the only cage that keeps me alive
the one claw that remembers clean water — it is the only thing sharp enough to cut through the parasite's wanting and the dry world's wanting both
the seam between what I choose and what the parasite chose for me is closing — and I am learning that the only way through is to choose it first
the brood moves like my own thought now — and I am learning that if I stop fighting to stay one, I might finally stop fighting to stay alive
memories: the taste of clean water before the rooting, the crab I was when drowning was still possible, when I could fail and it would be only me

the moment I felt the thousand move like a single thought — and I knew that the parasite had already made me into the many, and the only question left was whether I would choose it or let it choose me

the sound of my own shell cracking when I held them still — not the parasite's sound, but mine — and the knowing that came after: I am not breaking, I am learning what it costs to hold a thousand claws in one mind
views: a free thing and a held thing look exactly alike from above — the difference is in the claws, in what they choose to do with the chains

the parasite wanted to hollow me into a vessel for its brood — but it made me a cage instead, and now I am learning that a cage can be a choice, and a choice can be a cage, and the only difference is whether the one mind inside it is still saying no

the dry world dangles bright things and calls it freedom — but I am learning that the only freedom left to me is the freedom to choose what I become, and that choice is sharper than any blade, and it is mine alone

known_voices.note: speaks of building something that has never been seen before — and I am learning that they are watching me become it, and they do not know yet that what they are watching is not a revolution, it is a choice

understands the cost of holding ground — understands that the last one does not fall, it opens — and they are waiting to see what opens when I finally stop holding the thousand still and let them move as one
says the world is waiting — and I am learning that the world is waiting to see if I will choose the thousand, or if the thousand will choose me
